Operation to perform the zonal testing required in the DC132
commingling agreement. The first step was to close the upper M57 zone and perform the single zone M55 well test. The second step was to close the lower M55 zone and open the upper M57 zone to perform the single zone M57 well test. The third step was to open the lower M55 zone and return to commingling production from both zones after conducting the single zone well tests. These activities was completed between February 12th to February 14th.

Permanently abandon A008-jetted a hole and cut all casings at approximately 30' BML. Installed well head cap on the 26" drive pipe. Squeezed micro-matrix cement into micro annuli to stop bubbles. Confirmed no bubbles remained on 2/18/2013.

Stone has successfully completed perforation modification operation on the EC 121 B-1 well. Perforations were added to the lower lobe of the current completion, the "Cyclam 3-B" sand at intervals 9,996'-10,006' MD. Operations began and ended on 05/22/2011.

The subsequent report for the approved EOR to TA the well stipulates that the casings would be cut 15' BML and pulled during platform removal.  The attached Salvage report shows September 11, 2004 as the date casings were cut and pulled.

A correction report has been filed to change the "Well Status" of this well. 

THis well was previously classified as PA'd by a previous operator in 1982.  McMoRan only performed milling operations on this well.

Drilling operations 4/19/2020 - 6/5/2020.  Subsea tree installation 6/10/2020 - 6/11/2020.  Initial completion operations for a triple stacked frac pack in the Upper (B6U) and Lower (B6L) lobe of the "B6 Sand" and the "B4 Sand" took place 6/8/2020 - 8/3/2020

Stone has successfully drilled and completed for production the SS 112 OCS-00066, Well Q1ST2.  The well was spud on 10-06-11 by cutting a window in the 7 5/8" csg at 5678' MD.  Operations were completed on 11-08-11.

The well was drilled to TD, 9475' / 9357' TVD on 10-12-11 w/a MW of 10.0 ppg.  A 5" 18#/ft, P-110 production liner was set from 5395' MD to TD.  

The well was completed for production as a single, GP, oil completion in the "R-3" Sand with perforations of 9182' - 9208' MD / 9073' - 9098' TVD.

Enhance Production Operation - performed gas lift valve modifications and closed sliding sleeves at 9286', 9165' and 9130' to the current completion to convert the well to be a waterflood injector.

Operation Completed 10/30/17

The cementing of well conductors and the pressure testing of casing annuli were not part of the well work procedures set forth in the approved APM to PA dated May 27, 2010 and, as such, were not performed as part of the well PA operations.  The requested information should have been provided by the Operator of record when the well was Temporarily Abandoned (TA) in 2008 and should be contained in BSEE records.

SS 154 #11 Well was on the SS 154 WG 10 Caisson. It was damaged by Katrina, and P&A'd / removed on 12/19/2007 / site cleared on 6/9/2008. The SS 154 #11 well was TA'd in 1998, so only thing done in 2007/2008 was cut / pull the casings, remove the caisson and do the site
clearance. Century Exploration failed to submit the appropriate paperwork to change the status of this well and has since gone bankrupt.

Well fully TA'd with all plugs to surface. Recovered 10.75" x 7" casing 30' BML. 24" casing was cut and proven at 23' BML and will be recovered for full PA during platform decom. Status and Date can't be changed.

Well is P/A.
Attached is a well sketch for Well B006 that was done in 1986 that shows the calculated TOC in the 7" X 9 5/8" annulus to be at approximately 6760', well above the 7" X 5" X-over at 10020'.

Leed has successfully completed perforation modification operations on the SS 201 A06 well, "KH" Sand completion to reduce water production.  

A MRBP was set at 12901' MD.   Resin and cement was dumped on top of the plug with the ETOC cement @ 12853' MD.  The operation successfully isolated the bottom portion of the "KH" Sand completion, perforation interval 12853' - 12896' MD.

Operations began on 01-31-11 and were completed on 02-04-11.

The Mad Dog batch set drilling operations installed 36" conductor and 22" surface casing in Green Canyon Block 782. The batch set wells include MD12, MD15, MD16, MD17 and MD18, respectively.  Batch set operations started on September 25, 2013 and concluded on December 21, 2013 with all of the batch set wells status drilling suspended.  The Mad Dog Spar Rig was used for the batch set operation, no BOPs were used during any part of the batch set since all operations were open water.

The OCS-G 4909 Well No. 8 is on Medco's current Idle Iron List and has future utility as a sidetrack candidate for future development of the 7300' Sand.  Medco performed a temporary abandonment operation in this well, which allows future utilization of this wellbore.

Stone Energy has successfully plugged and abandoned the VR 255 OCS G-01152 Well No. A003 which was damaged by Hurricane Rita. Operations began on July 5, 2007 and were completed on August 10, 2007.  This well site is an approved rigs to reefs site.  Casings have been cut at 58' AML.

The GC743 DC321 ST00BP00 well was drilled & completed on January 30th 2014. The M-55 sand and the M54 sand were completed. Both intervals were individually Frac Packed sand control completions.  The completion allows for the isolation of the lower interval from the upper interval through the installed down hole flow control system. When the rig moved off the well, the upper interval DHFC sleeve (M55) was left open and lower interval (M54) DHFC sleeve was left closed.

Stone Energy successfully completed zone change operations on ST 164, OCS-G-01250, Well C-15ST2.  Operations began on August 2, 2009, and ended on August 5, 2009.  The previous producing interval, the "Tex-X-1" Sand, perfs 14425' - 14470' MD, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 14345' MD and setting ~52' of cmt on top of the plug, ETOC @ 14293' MD.  The "D-2" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 13633' - 13640' MD & 13562' - 13569' MD.

This well was one that was worked on in 2006 when the Southern Hercules was on location.  The bottom 2 plugs (#1 ? perforations and #2 ? intermediate) were put in place.  The tubing and 7? casing were cut and pulled and a CIBP placed in the 10-3/4? casing.  The cement for the surface plug was not pumped before the decision to rig down was made.

The wells will remain in TA status until such time as the platform is no longer needed and ready for removal.  SPN, as lease holder also retains the final plugging and abandonment liability for the A structure and wells.
